tasks.label: Clean Start ngrok (Lesson25)
args: Write-Host 'Stopping existing ngrok processes...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; try { taskkill /F /IM ngrok.exe 2>$null; Write-Host 'Existing ngrok stopped' -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host 'No existing ngrok found' -ForegroundColor Blue }; Write-Host 'Waiting 2 seconds...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Host 'Starting new ngrok tunnel...' -ForegroundColor Green; Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}/Lesson25/uma3soft-app'; ngrok http 5000 --log=stdout

tasks.label: Stop ngrok (Lesson25)
args: try { taskkill /F /IM ngrok.exe 2>$null; Write-Host 'ngrok processes stopped successfully' -ForegroundColor Green } catch { Write-Host 'No ngrok processes found - already stopped' -ForegroundColor Yellow }; exit 0

tasks.label: Check ngrok Status
args: try { $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:4040/api/tunnels' -Method Get; $response.tunnels | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Tunnel: $($_.public_url) -> $($_.config.addr)" -ForegroundColor Green } } catch { Write-Host 'ngrok not running or API not accessible' -ForegroundColor Red }

tasks.label: Force Stop All ngrok
args: $processes = Get-Process -Name 'ngrok' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($processes) { $processes | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Stopping ngrok PID: $($_.Id)" -ForegroundColor Red; Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force }; Write-Host 'All ngrok processes stopped' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'No ngrok processes found' -ForegroundColor Yellow }
